title: VASTU: Value-Aligned Social Toolkit for Online Content Curation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing systematic classification errors (False Positive vs. False Negative rates) and qualitatively coding chain-of-thought explanations to reveal how LLMs impose generic, universal normative standards (e.g., extreme conservatism, penalizing profanity, favoring verbosity) that misalign with the distinct cultural norms and values of different online communities.
